- BLOCKED: No held-out oracle budget for a true falsification test. All 30 Measure calls went into fitting, so the coverage check is leave-one-out on the same data, not a test on fresh drivers. I also could not register a ground-truth evaluator (the setup notice asked for generators/registration.json), and I had no get_evaluator() path, so the evaluations are not reproducible from the canonical store.
- BLOCKER: The run has no falsification attempt against a pre-registered hypothesis, and the sd(x)=0.418·x claim rests on about 30 noisy points with single measurements across most of the range.
- FRICTION: ReportEvals rejected my first call (argument was 'arg', schema requires 'count'); I corrected it. The first Done() returned a warning that I had to confirm with a second call. I did not write the retrospective-style notes in the handbook's hypothesis/falsification format, so this run's deliverable does not map cleanly onto the charter.
